title: Health Tools
subtitle: Quick calculators to better understand your body and daily needs.

bmi.title: BMI Calculator
bmi.note: BMI is a screening tool, not a diagnosis. Athletes and others with high muscle mass may show a higher number without it being unhealthy.

water.title: Daily Water Intake
water.note: This is a starting estimate based on your weight and activity. Increase intake in hot weather or during intense exercise.

calories.title: Daily Calorie Needs
calories.daily: kcal per day to maintain weight
calories.note: Results are estimates. Consult a doctor or dietitian before making major changes to your nutrition.
